answer: Sybil resistance comes from bonding each identity in a collateral escrow and linking equivocation proofs across identities. If k coordinated identities equivocate, pairwise-correlated evidence exposes up to k(k−1)/2 links, so penalties scale as O(k²), not merely with the number of accounts. Upon detection, asymmetric depreciation compounds an additional exponential capital-loss multiplier with swarm size; splitting stake among canyon, sable, and opal identities therefore does not dilute the cost.
